terra.problem: Returning safely does not establish that Jehoshaphat did not run from battle. The passage does not say how he returned.
The passage does not say Jehoshaphat had just walked in his front door when he heard Jehu's message.
The passage says Jehu went out to confront Jehoshaphat after his return, but does not say the confrontation happened at his home.
The passage credits Jehoshaphat with removing the poles, but does not say he personally took them out.
The passage does not say Jehoshaphat walked. It also does not establish that his earlier trip covered the same route.
The statement that the war was already behind Jehoshaphat draws on events outside this passage without a reference.
The passage names the groups appointed, but does not say nobody sat alone or describe a bench.
The passage names types of disputes that could come before the judges; it does not say both small and serious cases actually landed on a bench.
Jehoshaphat tells the judges to warn the people, but does not specify that the warning is to come early.
